name: Hairi
source:
A boy who sells newspapers and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsujiura]tsujiura[/url] on the street.
Because he was born with a rare colour, he was abandoned and brought up in an orphanage in Yomi.
He doesn't think kindly of the people who live on the surface.
